## Running Code

```{r}
require(knitr)
library(poolfstat)
setwd("/Users/rodenico/Documents/Pro/Articles/2023_CI_Experiment/202410MG/quarto_summary")
tmp=list.files("wolbachia_study_cache/html/")
tmp=tmp[grep("rdb",tmp)]
tmp=matrix(unlist(strsplit(tmp,split="\\.")),ncol=2,byrow=T)[,1]
for(i in tmp){lazyLoad(filebase = paste0("wolbachia_study_cache/html/",i))}

wRI.pooldata=vcf2pooldata(vcf.file="../ANA_102024/wRI.filtered.vcf.gz", poolsizes = all.sample.info[,1],poolnames = rownames(all.sample.info))

wRI.pooldata.unfiltered=vcf2pooldata(vcf.file="../ANA_102024/wRI.vcf.gz", poolsizes = all.sample.info[,1],poolnames = rownames(all.sample.info), min.maf=0.01, min.cov.per.pool=-1)

wRI.pooldata.unfiltered@snp.info

wRI.maf=0.5-abs(0.5-wRI.pooldata.unfiltered@refallele.readcount/wRI.pooldata.unfiltered@readcoverage)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
## Sample size for autosomes
all.sample.info[,1]
wRI.pooldata

## SNP infos
head(wRI.pooldata@snp.info)

## 98 SNPs
wRI.pooldata@nsnp

## 27 samples
wRI.pooldata@poolnames

## Matrix for coverage and readcounts with SNPs in rows and samples in columns
head(wRI.pooldata@readcoverage[, 1:20])

head(wRI.pooldata@refallele.readcount[, 1:20])


## 9 individual samples with fewer than 85% of the SNPs covered
ind.callrate <- apply(wRI.pooldata@readcoverage, 2, function(x) sum(x != 0)/nrow(wRI.pooldata@readcoverage))
sum(ind.callrate<=0.85)
wRI.pooldata@poolnames[ind.callrate<=0.85]

## Filter 9 individual samples with fewer than 85% of the SNPs covered
wRI.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wRI.pooldata,  pool.index = which(ind.callrate>0.85))

## 110 SNPs with fewer than 90% of individual samples covered
snp.callrate <- apply(wRI.pooldata@readcoverage, 1, function(x) sum(x != 0)/ncol(wRI.pooldata@readcoverage))
sum(snp.callrate<=0.9)

## Filter 110 SNPs with fewer than 90% of individual samples covered
wRI.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wRI.pooldata,  snp.index = which(snp.callrate>0.9))
```

```{r wRImafdistrib}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8 
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of the MAF of called wRI sites on all the samples ."
#| fig-cap-location: bottom
#| label: fig-wRImaf
wRI.freq=wRI.pooldata@refallele.readcount/wRI.pooldata@readcoverage
colnames(wRI.freq)=wRI.pooldata@poolnames

wRI.maf=0.5-abs(0.5-wRI.pooldata@refallele.readcount/wRI.pooldata@readcoverage)
colnames(wRI.maf)=wRI.pooldata@poolnames
sort(wRI.maf[, "Col-FR-Bal001"])
hist(wRI.maf[, "Col-FR-Bal001"])
hist(wRI.maf[, "Iso-FR-Par006"])

hist(wRI.maf[, "IT_Tre_Om300"])
hist(wRI.maf[, "JP-Tok"])
hist(wRI.maf[, "D-sub"])
hist(wRI.maf[, "CN-Kun_KM5"])

## Correlation among wSuz isolates 
plot(wRI.maf[, "Col-FR-Bal001"], wRI.maf[, "Iso-FR-Par006"], xlim=c(0, 0.5), ylim=c(0, 0.5))
abline(0, 1)

## Correlation among wSub isolates 
plot(wRI.maf[, "D-sub"], wRI.maf[, "CN-Kun_KM5"], xlim=c(0, 0.5), ylim=c(0, 0.5))
abline(0, 1)

## Weak or no correlation between frequency spectrum in pool and in isofemale strain
pairs(wRI.maf[, c("JP-Tok" , "Col-FR-Bal001")])

pairs(wRI.maf[, c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Iso-FR-Par006", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "IT_Tre_Om300")])
pairs(wRI.maf[, grep("Iso", wRI.pooldata@poolnames)])

meanIso <- rowMeans(wRI.maf[, grepl("Iso", wRI.pooldata@poolnames)&wRI.pooldata@poolnames!="Iso-JP-Tok003"])
hist(meanIso)
pairs(wRI.maf[meanIso < 0.05, grep("Iso", wRI.pooldata@poolnames)])
sum(meanIso > 0.05)
pairs(wRI.maf[meanIso < 0.05, grep("Iso", wRI.pooldata@poolnames)])
pairs(wRI.maf[meanIso < 0.05, grep("Col", wRI.pooldata@poolnames)])

boxplot(wRI.maf[meanIso < 0.05,],horizontal=T,las=1,xlab="MAF")

## Correlation among wRI isolates 
pairs(wRI.maf[, c("US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1")])
pairs(wRI.maf[meanIso < 0.05, c("US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1", "Col-FR-Bal001")])
pairs(wRI.maf[meanIso < 0.05, c("US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1", "Col-FR-Bal001")])

pairs(wRI.maf[meanIso < 0.05, c("US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1", "Col-FR-Bal001", "D-sub",  "CN-Kun_KM5")])

wRI.freq[meanIso < 0.05, c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-IT-Tre000", "D-sub",  "CN-Kun_KM5", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1")]
wRI.freq[meanIso < 0.05, c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-IT-Tre000", "D-sub", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1")]
mean(wRI.freq[meanIso < 0.05, c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-IT-Tre000", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1")])


Position <- wRI.pooldata@snp.info$Position[wRI.freq[, "D-sub"]==0&wRI.freq[, "Col-FR-Bal001"]>0]
```


```{r wRIpca}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 16 
#| fig-width: 24 
#| fig-cap: "Random allele PCA of Wolbachia SNPs on all the 27 samples."
#| fig-cap-location: bottom
#| label: fig-wRIpca

## Filter out bad SNPs
wRI.pooldata.filtered <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wRI.pooldata,  snp.index = which(meanIso < 0.05))

#boxplot(auto.pooldata@readcoverage)
wRI.pca=randomallele.pca(wRI.pooldata.filtered, plot.pcs = NULL)
pch.type =rep(16, wRI.pooldata.filtered@npools) ; pch.type[wRI.pooldata.filtered@poolsizes==2]=17
pch.col  = rep(3, wRI.pooldata.filtered@npools)

pch.col[which(grepl("Col-",wRI.pooldata@poolnames))]=5
pch.col[which(grepl("Om300",wRI.pooldata@poolnames) | grepl("Iso-",wRI.pooldata@poolnames))]=4
pch.col[which(grepl("sub",wRI.pooldata@poolnames) | grepl("CN-Kun",wRI.pooldata@poolnames))]=8
pch.col[which(grepl("sim",wRI.pooldata@poolnames))]=7

#plot(auto.pca$pop.loadings[,1:2],xlab=paste0("PC1 (",round(auto.pca$perc.var[1],2),"%)"),
#     ylab=paste0("PC2 (",round(auto.pca$perc.var[2],2),"%)"),
#     pch=pch.type,col=pch.col)
#text(auto.pca$pop.loadings[,1:2],auto.pooldata@poolnames,cex=0.5,pos=c(1,3)[order(auto.pca$pop.loadings[,1])%%2+1])

scree_data <- data.frame(PC = factor(paste0("PC", 1:length(wRI.pca$perc.var)),levels = paste0("PC", 1:length(wRI.pca$perc.var))),Variance = wRI.pca$perc.var)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(gridExtra)
# Plot the scree plot
tmp1 <- ggplot(scree_data, aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +  # Bar plot for explained variance
  geom_point(size = 2) +  # Add points to show individual PC values
  geom_line(group = 1, color = "black") +  # Line connecting the points
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot", x = "Principal Component", y = "Percentage of Explained Variance") +
  ylim(0, max(wRI.pca$perc.var))

data=as.data.frame(wRI.pca$pop.loadings)
colnames(data)=paste0("PC",1:ncol(data))
data$sample=wRI.pooldata@poolnames
data$group=paste0("G",pch.col)
data$group[pch.col==3]="Wild" ; data$group[pch.col==4]="Col" ; data$group[pch.col==5]="Iso"
data$group[pch.col==7]="Dsim" ; data$group[pch.col==8]="Dsuz" 
# Plot using ggplot and ggrepel to avoid overlapping labels
tmp2<-ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = sample,color=group)) +
  geom_point(size=1) +  # Plot points for each sample
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf) +  # Add sample names without overlapping
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (",round(wRI.pca$perc.var[1],2),"%)"), 
       y = paste0("PC2 (",round(wRI.pca$perc.var[2],2),"%)"), title = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(4,7,8,5,3)) 

tmp3<-ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC3, label = sample,color=group)) +
  geom_point(size=1) +  # Plot points for each sample
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf) +  # Add sample names without overlapping
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (",round(wRI.pca$perc.var[1],2),"%)"), 
       y = paste0("PC3 (",round(wRI.pca$perc.var[3],2),"%)"), title = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(4,7,8,5,3)) 

tmp4<-ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC4, label = sample,color=group)) +
  geom_point(size=1) +  # Plot points for each sample
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf) +  # Add sample names without overlapping
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (",round(wRI.pca$perc.var[1],2),"%)"), 
       y = paste0("PC4 (",round(wRI.pca$perc.var[4],2),"%)"), title = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(4,7,8,5,3)) 

grid.arrange(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, tmp4, ncol = 2)

rm(data)
```

```{r wRIpca}

set.seed(1234)
par(xpd=TRUE)
res.pca <- poolfstat::randomallele.pca(x = wRI.pooldata.filtered, plot.pcs = c(1, 2), return.snploadings = TRUE)

## Position of the SNPs contributing to the distinction between wRI / wSuz vs. Dsub (first axis of the PCA) 
plot(x=wRI.pooldata.filtered@snp.info$Position, y=res.pca$snp.loadings[,1]^2)

## Clustering of variants
fstats <- poolfstat::compute.fstats(x=wRI.pooldata.filtered, output.pairwise.div = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)

## Hirarchical clustering equivalent to UPGMA
tt=hclust(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div), method= "average")

## Neighbor joining distance
tt=ape::nj(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div))

#quartz()
## Heatmap
heatmap(fstats@pairwise.div, distfun = as.dist)
## Tree
plot(tt)
ape::plot.phylo(tt, type="radial", cex=0.5)

```
